config.title: Simple AI Committer
config.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API. Enter a URL directly, or run 'Simple AI Committer: Select API Base URL' to choose OpenAI, Kimi, DeepSeek, GLM, Ollama, or a custom URL.
config.apiKey.description: API key for the endpoint. You can enter it here; on first use the extension moves it to VS Code SecretStorage and this field then shows ***** instead of the plaintext. Equivalent to running 'Simple AI Committer: Set API Key'.
config.model.description: Model name to use (e.g. deepseek-chat, claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o)
config.systemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt sent to the LLM. The value shown above is the built-in English default; for the zh-cn display language a Chinese prompt is used until you change it.
config.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff characters, including file summaries and truncation notices. Must be a positive integer.
config.temperature.description: AI generation temperature (0-2); lower is more stable on models that still accept it. Default: -1 (omit the parameter), required by fixed-temperature models such as Claude, GPT-5.x and Kimi. Set 0-2 explicitly only for models that accept it.
config.timeoutMs.description: Total API request deadline in milliseconds (1-2147483647), including connection and response reception
config.gitPath.description: Path to git executable. Change this if git is not in your PATH (e.g. C:\Program Files\Git\bin\git.exe)
